checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so on the same page it counts as placed correctly.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead fee, with no other staff, facilities or handling fee.
D-embalming and the $795 Embalming price are both on page 1, so same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial or closed-casket service; only the standard embalming disclosure appears.
D-alt-container and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range are both on page 2, so same-page placement counts as correct.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container and wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
The list contains no optional combination package; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not counted as packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosures, and no required disclosure is shown printed in a hard-to-notice way.
